inherited_rules.capacity_rule: K=floor(q*N), actual 0/1 lists for every policy
inherited_rules.random_rule: sort by source_row_proxy, fixed permutation, first K; same permutation across capacities
inherited_rules.estimand: E[a(X)*(Y(1)-Y(0))], relative to sending no email to all eligible customers
inherited_rules.display_unit: incremental purchases per 10000 eligible customers, not per 10000 selected customers

bootstrap.resampling: paired customer rows, separately within each T arm, preserving arm sizes
bootstrap.conditioning: fixed fitted model, scores and original selection indicators; no refit or reranking

inherited_rules.final_test_rule: Keep all four rules, the stage-07 model and all capacities fixed. No validation winner selection. Final test primary contrast is uplift minus p1 at 20%; other contrasts/capacities are auxiliary exploration.
inherited_rules.selection_context: Recorded before first validation-Y analysis in this stage; earlier training analyses have been inspected.

payload.inherited_rules_note: 继承配置中的validation表示规则来源；本次评价数据及输出集合均为test。
payload.overall_effect: planned auxiliary T1-T0 14-day conversion difference; Wilson arms/Newcombe pointwise 95%
payload.no_new_search: No model/feature/subgroup/prior/capacity search; no refit on train+validation.
payload.evaluation_scope: Final held-out evaluation under frozen rules; identical rerun is not a new experiment.
